The equation factors as
\[
a^2b+b^2c+c^2a-ab^2-bc^2-ca^2=(a-b)(b-c)(a-c).
\]
Thus solutions are exactly ordered triples with at least two of \(a,b,c\) equal.

Let \(A=\{a=b\}\), \(B=\{b=c\}\), \(C=\{c=a\}\). Each has size \(100^2\), each pairwise intersection has size \(100\), and the triple intersection has size \(100\). Therefore
\[
|A\cup B\cup C|
=3(100^2)-3(100)+100
=30000-300+100
=29800.
\]

\[
\boxed{29800}
\]
